top_signals.title: Qatar deal to buy U.S. natural gas shows how Iran war has redrawn global energy markets
top_signals.summary: The Iran war is transforming global energy markets and benefiting U.S. companies, especially liquefied natural gas exporters.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
